profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Application Developer with experience in both desktop and web-based application development, database development, software testing, network troubleshooting, and helpdesk services. Particularly interested in software development projects.

Specialties: ADO,  Adobe Photoshop,  ASP,  C,  Crystal Reports,  CSS, HTML, JavaScript, Mac OS,  Networking basics, SQL, Tech Support & Troubleshooting, VBScript, Visual Basic, Windows Operating Systems; Customer Relations, Customer Service, Sales, Fluent in Spanish, Teaching & Presentations

positions.title: Customer Helpdesk
positions.description:
- Addressing client needs and entering the issue into a ticketing system to be tracked and logged appropriately
 
 - Fixing minor issues relating to front-end web development, while supporting a client in a time of stress and need
 
 - Escalating all other client-server technology issues to the engineering staff and production support team
 
 - Minor CSS, HTML break fix / hot fix troubleshooting as needed

positions.title: Level 1 Technical Support Representative
positions.description:
Handle incoming support calls from end users at various client properties.
Trouble-shoot end user devices & connectivity issues. 
Properly document & track trouble-shooting procedures using proprietary ticketing software.

positions.title: Associate Developer
positions.description:
Isolate and repair reported errors in software.
Design and implement new features & enhancements for the desktop application using Visual Basic &  MS SQL. 
Update older code to current software specifications.

positions.title: Customer Specialist
positions.description:
Enhanced teaching skills by providing targeted training & product knowledge to new employees.
Developed customer service skills by assisting customers with questions and following up with & resolving sales/customer issues.

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Created & implemented logical and physical database models using MS SQL.
Designed UIs for web-based applications.
Implemented UIs using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, ASP, & ADO.

positions.title: Computer Consultant
positions.description:
Provided helpdesk support for college computer systems & applications.
Assisted students, faculty, and staff with usage of college's computer system.
Diagnosed & repaired faulty computers & files.
Developed & maintained college departmental web sites.
